passage:
A student used a funny name and cartoon picture online. He felt free to say things he would never say at school.
One day, a comment hurt another student. Even though his real name was hidden, the harm was real.
The teacher discussed online identity with the class. Being anonymous can protect privacy and allow honest speech, but it can also tempt people to forget responsibility.
The student apologized.
The lesson was clear. A screen name may hide a face, but it does not erase the person receiving the words.
Digital masks should not become excuses for cruelty.
